consent.bannerBody: Atlas stores a small amount of data in your browser. Some of it is required to keep you signed in. The rest only remembers your preferences, and you can decline it.
consent.dialogBody: Atlas uses no analytics, advertising or third-party tracking technologies. These are the only two categories that exist.
consent.necessaryBody: Keeps you signed in and remembers which organization and academy you are working in. Atlas cannot function without this, so it cannot be turned off.
consent.preferencesBody: Remembers your theme, language, sidebar layout and similar choices. Declining removes what is already stored and Atlas will simply use its defaults.
consent.decisionSaved: Your cookie preferences have been saved.
